answer_1.quote: ExpandR first prompts the LLM to generate semantically enriched query expansions, which enhance query representations and improve the retriever's ability to rank relevant documents.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate retrieval effectiveness using two retrieval benchmarks: MS MARCO  and BEIR . Evaluation Metrics. We use nDCG@10 as the evaluation metric, which is the official evaluation metric of BEIR .

answer_3.quote: To examine how the quality of LLM-generated query expansions affects retrieval performance, we conduct a bucket-based analysis  using an LLM-as-judge protocol . Specifically, GPT-4o is prompted to assign faithfulness scores ranging from 1 to 5 to each expansion, measuring how well it reflects both the original query and its ground-truth document.
